tldr: 台股 11 月 20 日崩跌 6.23% 收 36,033.29 點，單週創 1991 年以來最慘，全球 AI 與晶片股賣壓重創科技權重偏高的台股。
賣壓席捲全亞洲，南韓 Kospi 跌約 5.2%、日經跌 5.1%，在美掛牌的台積電 ADR 與超微盤前續跌。
美股那斯達克跌約 5.3%，標普 500 與道瓊收盤跌入修正區，輝達全週跌幅上看逾一成。
金價跌至 2025 年 9 月以來低點、比特幣逼近五個月低點，鷹派聯準會升高 12 月升息預期。
國內方面，金管會預告穩定幣與虛擬資產子法，多份報告顯示台灣高資產財富規模持續攀升。

items.title_zh: 台股崩跌 6.23% 單週創 1991 年來最慘
items.title_en: Taiex plunges 6.23% to cap its worst week since 1991
items.summary_zh: 台股 11 月 20 日（週五）重挫 2,393.60 點、跌幅 6.23%，收 36,033.29 點，為史上第五大盤中跌點，全球 AI 與晶片股賣壓擴大，重創科技權重偏高的台股。成交量放大至約 8,773.5 億元。本週累計下跌約 17.5%，為 1991 年以來最慘單週表現，凸顯市場對 AI 高評價的信心快速轉向，資金從高本益比科技股撤離，短線觀望氣氛濃厚。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark Taiex sank 2,393.60 points, or 6.23%, to close at 36,033.29 on Friday, Nov 20, its fifth-largest intraday point loss on record, as a deepening global selloff in AI and chip stocks battered the tech-heavy market. Turnover swelled to about NT$877.35 billion. For the week the index shed roughly 17.5%, its steepest weekly drop since 1991, underscoring how fast sentiment has turned on stretched AI valuations.

items.title_zh: AI 晶片賣壓席捲亞股 南韓、日股同步重挫
items.title_en: AI-chip rout spreads across Asia as Kospi, Nikkei tumble with Taiex
items.summary_zh: 11 月 20 日亞股全面走弱，南韓 Kospi 下跌約 5.2%、日經 225 跌約 5.1%，與台股同步下挫，投資人競相撤出 AI 相關個股。晶片廠與供應鏈領跌，惟部分業者表示在手訂單仍穩定，凸顯基本面韌性與股價崩跌之間的落差擴大。本週 Kospi 累跌 7.9%、日經跌 7.7%，反映 AI 投資疑慮已非單一市場現象，而是跨區域的系統性修正。
items.summary_en: The selloff was region-wide on Friday: South Korea's Kospi fell about 5.2% and Japan's Nikkei 225 dropped around 5.1%, mirroring Taiwan's slide as investors fled AI-related names. Chipmakers and suppliers led losses even as some report order books remain steady, highlighting a widening gap between resilient fundamentals and collapsing share prices. For the week, the Kospi lost 7.9% and the Nikkei 7.7%.

items.title_zh: 亞洲科技與晶片股重挫 Anthropic 美股強勢掛牌仍難止血
items.title_en: Asian tech and chip stocks plunge despite Anthropic's strong Wall Street debut
items.summary_zh: 儘管台積電持股的 AI 開發商 Anthropic 於美股強勢掛牌，亞洲科技股（尤以晶片股為首）11 月 20 日仍全面下挫，市場對 AI 投資規模與回收年限的疑慮未解。個別 AI 贏家獲追捧、整體硬體供應鏈評價卻遭調降，凸顯資金對「建置資料中心算力」題材由全面擁抱轉為選擇性押注，台廠 AI 供應鏈評價短線承壓。
items.summary_en: Asian technology shares, led by chip names, tumbled on Friday as worries over the scale and payback of AI spending persisted, even after AI developer Anthropic — in which TSMC holds a stake — made a strong US market debut. The disconnect shows investors rewarding individual AI winners while broadly derating the hardware supply chain that builds out data-center capacity.

items.title_zh: 台積電 ADR 與超微續跌 晶片賣壓由亞洲蔓延至美股盤前
items.title_en: TSMC ADR and AMD slide further as chip selloff jumps from Asia to US premarket
items.summary_zh: 11 月 20 日美股盤前，在美掛牌的台積電 ADR 下跌約 4.2%、超微（AMD）再跌約 7%，那斯達克期貨下滑 1.6%，亞洲晶片賣壓延燒至華爾街。此波走勢凸顯台積電居 AI 供應鏈核心地位——幾乎所有領先晶片設計商都仰賴其製造與封裝先進處理器，一旦 AI 資本支出預期降溫，台積電與整條供應鏈評價首當其衝，牽動台廠出貨與接單能見度。
items.summary_en: US-listed Taiwan Semiconductor fell about 4.2% and AMD dropped another 7% in Friday premarket trade, with Nasdaq futures down 1.6%, as Asia's chip rout carried into Wall Street. The moves underline TSMC's position at the center of the AI supply chain — nearly every leading chip designer relies on it to manufacture and package advanced processors, so a cooling in AI capex expectations hits the whole chain first.

items.title_zh: 金管會預告穩定幣與虛擬資產子法 完善 VASP 監理架構
items.title_en: FSC previews stablecoin and virtual-asset sub-laws under new VASP Act
items.summary_zh: 金管會預告《虛擬資產服務法》9 項授權子法草案，預告期 40 天，其中包含穩定幣發行許可及管理辦法。草案規定非銀行發行人資本額門檻為 3 億元，穩定幣可與新台幣或單一外幣 1 比 1 連結（不含人民幣等），準備資產總值不得低於流通在外餘額並須定期由會計師查核。法規最快 2027 年上路，為台灣穩定幣與虛擬資產市場建立發行與贖回的合規框架。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission has opened a 40-day comment period on nine draft sub-regulations implementing the Virtual Asset Service Providers Act, including rules governing stablecoin issuance. Non-bank issuers would need NT$300 million in capital, and stablecoins could be pegged 1:1 to the NT dollar or a single foreign currency (excluding the yuan), with reserves fully backing coins in circulation and audited periodically.

items.title_zh: 金管會公布第五屆永續金融評鑑指標
items.title_en: FSC rolls out fifth-round sustainable-finance evaluation metrics
items.summary_zh: 金管會公布第五屆（116 年）永續金融評鑑指標，延續以評分引導銀行、保險與證券業強化綠色金融與 ESG 作為的政策，促使資金投向永續目標。此舉呼應主管機關推動綠色投資的方向，將融資導入淨零轉型，為台灣氣候轉型與金融穩定議程的一環，業者後續在永續揭露與投融資配置的落實程度，將成為市場與主管機關關注重點。
items.summary_en: The FSC announced the indicators for its fifth (2027-cycle) sustainable-finance evaluation, continuing a program that scores banks, insurers and securities firms on their green-finance and ESG practices to steer capital toward sustainability goals. The move reinforces regulators' push to channel financing into green investment as part of Taiwan's broader climate-transition and financial-stability agenda.

items.title_zh: 高資產人口估增至 12.4 萬人 持有資產 46 兆元
items.title_en: High-net-worth population seen rising to 124,000 holding NT$46 trillion
items.summary_zh: KPMG 與玉山銀行報告估計，台灣資產逾新台幣 1 億元的高資產人口將由 2023 年的 9.3 萬人，增至 2026 年約 12.4 萬人，持有資產約 46.1 兆元，ETF 與高資產業務為主要成長動能。數據顯示財富版圖快速質變，高資產客群關注焦點由單純追求資產增值，逐步轉向完善跨世代傳承規劃，帶動信託、保險與海外資產配置等傳承型商品需求同步升溫。
items.summary_en: A KPMG–E.Sun study estimates Taiwan's population with NT$100 million-plus in assets will grow from 93,000 in 2023 to an estimated 124,000 in 2026, holding about NT$46.1 trillion, with ETFs and high-net-worth services the main engines of expansion. The data point to a fast-shifting wealth landscape as affluent clients move from pure asset growth toward cross-generational succession planning.

items.title_zh: 中信與 BCG 報告：2029 年高資產財富上看 59 兆元
items.title_en: CTBC–BCG study sees HNW wealth reaching NT$59 trillion by 2029
items.summary_zh: 中國信託銀行與 BCG 報告預估，台灣高資產客群的個人財富總額將於 2029 年達約 59 兆元，客群人數增至約 15.5 萬人。此預測凸顯高資產族群動能延續，也反映銀行為爭取傳承、信託與跨境資產管理業務的競爭加劇。隨高資產需求由財富積累轉向財富保全與移轉，私人銀行與家族辦公室服務將成為各大金融機構布局財管版圖的關鍵戰場。
items.summary_en: A study by CTBC Bank and BCG projects that the total personal wealth of Taiwan's high-net-worth clients will climb to about NT$59 trillion by 2029, with the number of such clients rising to roughly 155,000. The forecast underscores sustained momentum in the affluent segment and intensifying competition among banks to capture succession, trust and cross-border asset-management mandates.

items.title_zh: 長照特別扣除額擬調高至 18 萬元 回溯適用今年
items.title_en: Long-term care tax deduction set to rise to NT$180,000, backdated to 2026
items.summary_zh: 立法院朝野就提高長期照顧特別扣除額取得共識，擬由每名符合資格者 12 萬元提高至 18 萬元，並可望回溯自今年 1 月 1 日適用。此調整將減輕有長照需求家庭的稅負，並反映於 2027 年 5 月的綜所稅申報，有扶養被照顧者的納稅人可留意最終立法進度與適用條件，提前備妥長照資格證明等文件。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese lawmakers have reached cross-party consensus to raise the long-term care special deduction from NT$120,000 to NT$180,000 per qualifying person, with the change expected to apply retroactively from Jan 1 this year. The move would ease the tax burden on households caring for dependents and feed into the May 2027 filing season.

items.title_zh: 物價連動 綜所稅免稅額與扣除額調高 2027 年 5 月申報適用
items.title_en: Inflation-linked bump lifts income-tax allowances for the 2027 filing season
items.summary_zh: 反映累計通膨，綜所稅免稅額調升至每人 10.1 萬元（70 歲以上 15.5 萬元），標準扣除額提高至 13.6 萬元，5% 課稅級距上限放寬至 61 萬元。相關調整適用於 2026 年度所得、於 2027 年 5 月申報，有助小幅減輕受薪家庭稅負；以租屋自住的單身上班族為例，免稅門檻約達 64.4 萬元，可留意年底前的節稅與扣除額規劃。
items.summary_en: Reflecting cumulative inflation, Taiwan's personal income-tax exemption is set to rise to NT$101,000 (NT$155,000 for those aged 70+) and the standard deduction to NT$136,000, with the 5% bracket widened to income up to NT$610,000. The adjustments apply to the 2026 tax year, filed in May 2027, modestly lowering the burden for salaried households.

items.title_zh: 央行最新預測：2026 經濟成長上看逾 11% AI 熱潮為引擎
items.title_en: Central bank's latest forecast sees 2026 growth above 11% on AI boom
items.summary_zh: 中央銀行最新預測將 2026 年經濟成長率上修至約 11.48%，上半年成長估達 14.15%，主要受惠 AI 與高效能運算（HPC）需求暢旺，帶動出口與民間投資。此次上修使台灣成長率維持在近數十年高點，惟在高比較基期下，後續成長料逐步回歸常態，結構性出口動能能否延續，以及全球 AI 投資熱度變化，為後市觀察重點。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's central bank has lifted its 2026 GDP growth forecast to about 11.48%, with first-half growth estimated near 14.15%, driven by robust demand for AI and high-performance computing that has powered exports and private investment. The upgrade keeps Taiwan's growth near multi-decade highs, though a high base points to normalization in the quarters ahead.

items.title_zh: 央行估今年通膨略高於 2% 明年可望回落
items.title_en: Central bank expects inflation slightly above 2% this year, easing in 2027
items.summary_zh: 中央銀行預期今年消費者物價通膨率略高於 2%，隨國際油價回落，明年可望降至 2% 目標以下，貨幣政策維持穩健基調。央行也示警地緣政治與能源價格波動為通膨展望的主要上行風險，將持續觀察國際情勢與輸入性物價壓力，作為後續利率決策的重要依據，市場亦關注央行對高漲資產價格的看法。
items.summary_en: The central bank projects consumer inflation running a little above 2% this year before cooling below the 2% target in 2027 as international oil prices retreat, keeping monetary policy on a steady footing. Officials flagged geopolitical tensions and energy-price swings as the main upside risks to the inflation outlook.

items.title_zh: AI 評價疑慮重創全球股市 美股基準指數跌入修正
items.title_en: Global markets slammed by AI-valuation fears as US benchmarks correct
items.summary_zh: 以 AI 與晶片股為核心的全球賣壓本週加劇，美媒報導標普 500 與道瓊收盤跌入修正區間，那斯達克抹去 2026 年全年漲幅。由於標普 500 約半數成分股與 AI 題材相關，市場對資料中心支出規模與回收的疑慮，透過供應鏈與資金面擴散至全球股市，亞股與歐股同步走低，台股亦難置身事外，短線評價修正壓力明顯。
items.summary_en: A worldwide selloff centered on AI and chip stocks deepened this week, with US coverage noting the S&P 500 and Dow closing in correction territory and the Nasdaq erasing its 2026 gain. With roughly half of the S&P 500 tied to the AI theme, doubts over the scale and payoff of data-center spending rippled across global equity markets, dragging Asian and European indexes lower in tandem.

items.title_zh: 聯準會轉鷹 市場指向 12 月可能升息 壓抑風險資產
items.title_en: Hawkish Fed turn points to a likely December rate hike, pressuring risk assets
items.summary_zh: 在聯準會會議紀要偏鷹、通膨數據轉熱後，市場已轉為押注 12 月幾乎確定升息 1 碼，CME FedWatch 顯示機率逾九成，部分官員甚至不排除更大幅度。緊縮（而非降息）的政策預期，進一步壓抑全球股市、黃金與加密貨幣，與 AI 評價疑慮形成雙重利空，推升跨市場避險情緒，資金流向高評價科技股的意願明顯下降。
items.summary_en: Markets have swung to pricing a near-certain 25-basis-point Federal Reserve rate hike in December — with CME FedWatch odds cited above 90% — after hawkish Fed minutes and hotter inflation data, with some officials even floating a larger move. The prospect of tighter policy, rather than cuts, added to pressure on equities, gold and crypto worldwide.

items.title_zh: 美股重挫 標普與道瓊跌入修正區（2026-11-20）
items.title_en: US stocks slammed as S&P 500 and Dow fall into correction (2026-11-20)
items.summary_zh: 美股週五崩跌，那斯達克指數下跌約 5.3% 至 22,617.73 點，標普 500 跌 3.7% 收 6,910.39 點，道瓊跌 1.9% 收 48,147.33 點。此波跌勢使標普與道瓊正式跌入修正區間，那斯達克今年以來轉為翻黑。全週那斯達克累跌約 10%、標普跌 8.6%、道瓊跌 8%，AI 高評價疑慮主導賣壓。
items.summary_en: Wall Street tumbled Friday, with the Nasdaq Composite sliding about 5.3% to 22,617.73, the S&P 500 down 3.7% to 6,910.39 and the Dow off 1.9% to 48,147.33. The drop pushed the S&P 500 and Dow into correction and turned the Nasdaq negative for 2026. For the week the Nasdaq lost about 10%, the S&P 8.6% and the Dow 8%.

items.title_zh: 輝達本週跌幅上看逾一成 AI 疑慮升溫（2026-11-20）
items.title_en: Nvidia on track for a weekly loss of more than 10% as AI doubts mount (2026-11-20)
items.summary_zh: 輝達股價週五再度下跌，連續第 7 個交易日走低，全週跌幅上看逾 10%，反映投資人對 AI 高評價的疑慮。同業超微（AMD）同步重挫。作為 AI 指標股，輝達此波回檔凸顯市場對該題材的熱度快速降溫，資金自高本益比半導體股撤出，牽動全球 AI 供應鏈評價與風險偏好。
items.summary_en: Nvidia shares fell again on Friday, extending a seven-session losing streak and putting the stock on course to end the week down more than 10% amid investor concerns over stretched AI valuations. Peer AMD also slumped sharply. The retreat in the AI bellwether underscored how quickly enthusiasm for the trade has cooled.

items.title_zh: 金價跌至 2025 年 9 月以來低點 避險賣壓擴散（2026-11-20）
items.title_en: Gold sinks to its lowest since September 2025 as risk-off selling spreads (2026-11-20)
items.summary_zh: 12 月黃金期貨週五結算價每盎司 3,515.40 美元，單日下跌約 4.6%、全週跌約 9.5%，為 2025 年 9 月以來最低，避險賣壓蔓延至貴金屬。油價同步走低，西德州原油約 84 美元，受中東出口供給充足影響連續第 3 週下跌，反映資金在高波動環境下重新調整資產配置。
items.summary_en: December gold settled at $3,515.40 an ounce on Friday, down about 4.6% on the day and roughly 9.5% for the week — its lowest since September 2025 — as a broad risk-off move hit precious metals. Oil also fell, with WTI near $84 and crude posting a third straight weekly decline on strong Middle East export flows.

items.title_zh: 比特幣逼近五個月低點 鷹派聯準會升高 12 月升息預期（2026-11-19）
items.title_en: Bitcoin nears a five-month low as a hawkish Fed lifts December rate-hike bets (2026-11-19)
items.summary_zh: 比特幣下跌至近五個月低點，一度跌破 6.3 萬美元，有望連續第 7 週收黑；黃金同步走低，市場在通膨數據偏熱後，押注聯準會 12 月可能升息。政策預期由降息轉向緊縮，明顯削弱市場對風險性資產的胃納，資金轉趨保守，牽動加密貨幣與貴金屬同步承壓。
items.summary_en: Bitcoin slid toward a near five-month low, slipping below the $63,000 area and heading for a seventh straight weekly loss, while gold also fell as traders priced in a likely December Federal Reserve rate hike following hotter inflation data. The shift to expecting tighter policy — rather than cuts — sapped appetite for risk assets across markets.
